capacity_contract.common_support: intersection of events with exactly K visible evidence items in every selector arm

frozen_verifier.interpretation: diagnostic input-organization gate under a verifier trained on stateful prompts

activity_gate.measure: fraction of common-support events with a different visible UID set or order

primary.name: S_minus_O
primary.question: Does state-conditioned rescoring improve over a frozen initial ranking?

secondary_holm_family.name: S_minus_H
secondary_holm_family.question: Does learned continuous utility improve over the stateful hard rule?

secondary_holm_family.name: H_minus_R
secondary_holm_family.question: Does the structure-induced rule improve over retrieval order?

secondary_holm_family.name: S_minus_shuffle_seed0
secondary_holm_family.question: Does stateful presentation order improve over a strict same-set shuffle?

decision_rule.green: macro-F1 delta >= 0.005 and paired-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
decision_rule.yellow: macro-F1 delta > 0 but the green rule is not met
decision_rule.order_robustness: at least four of five shuffle-seed macro-F1 deltas must be positive for a robust order claim

method_branches.H_minus_R_red: structure mechanism unsupported; do not scale the clean mechanism story
method_branches.H_minus_R_positive_and_S_minus_H_red: retain the hard structure rule and drop learned-utility benefit
method_branches.S_minus_O_red: drop the state-conditioned rescoring benefit claim
method_branches.S_minus_shuffle_not_robust: drop the presentation-order benefit claim without rejecting evidence selection
